name: hax-in-a-minute-tools
description: Render the HAX in a minute doodle board to MP4, GIF, PNG stills and PPTX

scripts.stills: node render.js stills ../media/stills '{"names":"[\"what-is-hax\",\"ecosystem\",\"magic-script\",\"pillars\",\"lift-off\"]"}' && node render.js stills ../media/stills '{"scheme":"dark","suffix":"-dark","names":"[\"what-is-hax\",\"ecosystem\",\"magic-script\",\"pillars\",\"lift-off\"]"}'
scripts.all: npm run stills && npm run mp4 && npm run gif && npm run pptx
